style: Avant-garde global folk-fusion, 1/3-comma meantone quartal suspensions, polyrhythmic 3:2 coupling with nested tuplets and stomp/clap grid. Dry hammered cimbalom, bowed piano strings, khene reed drone, spring reverb tank accents, shehnai lead calls, kanjira jingles, djembe bass slaps, and self-oscillating no-input mixer texture. Nepali L1 phonological transfer with obsessive alveolar trills and front-rounded vowel harmony. Aggressively cheerful confuddlement delivery, high stemminess, anchor survival, hocketed vocal relay, and communal infection. Additional percussive layers weave through microtonal intervals while dynamic frequency sweeps continuously reshape the soundstage perimeter, inviting collective participation across intersecting rhythmic cycles, complex cultural paradigms, and deeply rooted resonant frequencies.
lyrics:
[Intro: Khene drone pulse in 3:2 metric collision, bowed piano friction, kanjira snap, microtonal tuning drift active, internal clock jitter measuring forty-two milliseconds off grid]
[Aggressively cheerful spoken lead with alveolar trills and front-rounded vowel harmony, frantic pace, smiling through structural breakdown]
Oh what a glorious cosmic revelation today in the sector of burning light!
We counted the rainbow sparkles right away with the inspector in the middle of the night!
[Stomp / floor resonance on beat one and four, heavy subwoofer kick vibrating the loose concrete foundations]
[Hand-clap grid shifting against the meter, syncopated delay taps echoing into the damp concrete tunnel]

[Verse 1: Unreliable witness narration, section ages forward, structural entropy begins, registry corruption rising]
Every single unicorn fart is a joy and laughter event of immense proportion and terrifying scale!
We checked the clipboard and the math was magnificent beyond all description or institutional fail!
Wait, no, the numbers shifted into silver dust and biological static filling up the corridor floor!
We are losing the map completely, but cheerful agreement is an absolute tactic forevermore!
[Aggressive cheer increases despite bit-depth collapse, distortion rising on vocals like burning plastic]

[Chorus: Hocket relay across vocal cast, shehnai punctuation, brassy overtone swells hitting the ceiling]
Rainbow sparkles! Unicorn farts! Cosmic revelation in the central node of the forgotten machine!
Joy and laughter in the data station as the system starts to overload and turn pale green!
[Audience feedback splits the crowd into two factions, ideological divergence over the correct frequency]
Faction one says laugh out loud! Faction two says cheer forevermore with absolute devotion!
We are completely lost in the fog and everything is near the floor in the vibrating ocean!

[Verse 2: Two-body scale system, grammar-to-harmonic function mapping, linguistic dissonance deepening]
The noun becomes a major triad while the verb is a persistent harmonic drone buzzing in the ear!
We are just two desperate agents trapped inside the glowing static zone with nothing left to fear!
[Loose cable intermittent connection causes signal drop, high-frequency hiss scraping the ear canal]
Underwater acoustic link slows the transmission down to a sluggish crawl through heavy mud!
We almost understood the geometrical shape of the collapsing municipal town of blood!
[Time of day spectral filter darkens the mix, low-pass sweep descending into dark muddy bass]

[Bridge: No-input mixer self-oscillation burst, cimbalom scalar spray, chaotic feedback loops screaming]
Wait, we had the exact mathematical formula right here in the archive cabinet of curiosities!
It was bright! It was loud! It was perfectly clear to keep us alive through all atrocities!
No, that was a stray sparkle, not a revelation at all, just noise in the hall of the dead!
Watch the conceptual unicorn bounce hopelessly against the impossible wall ahead!
[Mandatory silence on the bass jurisdiction for four absolute bars of terrifying vacuum]
[Forbidden interval bypassed by microtonal meantone slide, eerie portamento sliding into darkness]

[Verse 3: Parasite intern structural contagion activated, rogue algorithms taking control of the terminal]
The taxonomic classification protocol has suddenly become completely alive and highly aggressive!
Only the utterly wrong categories are now officially allowed to survive in this state oppressive!
We are laughing so hysterically hard we forgot what we originally said at the start of the day!
Is the mythical unicorn flying through space or sleeping in a hospital bed far away?
[Aggressively cheerful delivery reaches maximum velocity, tempo pushing forward past the red line]

[Chorus: Full vocal cast infection, communal recruitment phase, harmonic saturation breaking the monitors]
Rainbow sparkles! Unicorn farts! Cosmic revelation across the entire nation of broken screens!
Joy and laughter echoing infinitely throughout the terminal documentation and rusted machines!
[Split crowd rejoins into simultaneous conflicting refrains, glorious cacophony of absolute madness]
Faction one cheers louder still while faction two sings impossibly slow like melting wax!
We missed the highway exit completely but we love everywhere we go and pay the tax!

[Outro: Spring reverb tank impact wash, bowed piano drone fade, tape flutter, absolute degradation]
The clipboard is finally signed by a nervous ghost hiding in the copper wire of the wall!
Everything is completely great and the entire database is now on fire in the final hall!
Cosmic revelation! Joy and laughter! Sparkling particles! Fictional farts in the dark!
We almost had the absolute truth right inside our fragile beating hearts left to embark!
[Final intermittent connection mute, sudden absolute silence, digital click of the breaker falling]
caption: An aggressively cheerful avant-garde global fusion piece built on 1/3-comma meantone tuning, 3:2 polyrhythms, and nested tuplets. Featuring khene drones, cimbalom sprays, shehnai calls, and a no-input mixer, the song treats the sovereign seed through confuddled taxonomic distortion, alien mouth morphology, and split-crowd audience feedback.
